definitions.explanation: The natural satellite of the Earth, visible in the night sky.
A period of approximately 30 days, one of twelve divisions of the year.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{月|つき}がきれいです。
{来|らい}{月|げつ}{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'm going to Japan next month.
examples.notes: Using げつ reading for month

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}{月|つき}にいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is it per month?

notes: Read as つき for 'moon' and when counting months ({一|ひと}{月|つき}, one month). Read as げつ or がつ in compounds: {来月|らいげつ} (next month), {一|いち}{月|がつ} (January). {月見|つきみ} (moon viewing) is a traditional autumn activity.
